purpose_context: Felix's observation-digest subsystem still writes raw agent-activity logs into a stray directory on the service account that isn't backed up with Kent's vault. A prior fix (#656) relocated the inbox logs but had to leave this one in place. This mission repoints the remaining writer to the backed-up location, migrates the existing logs, and fully decommissions the stray directory so there is one clear home for Felix's activity records.
purpose_tldr: Move Felix's agent-activity logs onto Kent's backed-up account and retire the stray directory left behind by #656.
